dispute.claim_text: Wah lau this driver take me all the way to Jurong Point for what?? My trip is Clementi to Bukit Batok only, 6km thing become 14km, 34 minutes for a 15 minute trip. He anyhow drive to increase the fare. $21.32 for such a short trip is not reasonable at all. Refund the extra, this kind of driver should be banned lah.

counterparty_statement.text: She asked me in the chat to stop at Jurong Point first to buy something, I said ok and waited six minutes at the PHV pickup point for her. Now she says I anyhow drive. The app also did not charge her for the full distance, I drove 13.8 km and the receipt shows 9.6 km.
